**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).** Incident is still open.

Root cause is `dep-4471`, which set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` at `02:13:41`. The pool is `size=20`. Per-request checkout drains it at once.

Impact ran `02:14:18.972Z` to `03:59:27.974Z`, still going. 530 requests failed, all `503`. Churn hit `4180 opens in the last 5m, baseline is 40`.

The log is `node-3 of 3`. Fleet impact is likely near 3x.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`, then check nodes 1 and 2.
